name: Sika® Level SkimCoat
tagline: Fast setting, cement based smoothing and finishing skim coat for internal use.
summary: Sika® Level SkimCoat is a one-component, easy to use and fast drying, cementitious skim mortar ideal for the repair or reprofiling of concrete, approved wood subfloors, and correctly prepared ceramic or quarry tiles before the installation of SikaFloor® Levelling products, SikaTile® adhesives or final floor coverings. Sika® Level SkimCoat can be installed as a true featheredge as well as filling voids and leveling defects up to 13 mm in depth.

packaging: 4.5 kg bag. Pack of 4 bags per box

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in original, un-opened and undamaged sealed packaging.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.
Protect from moisture. If damp, discard material

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: 2 qts. (1.9 L) of water per 10 lb. (4.5 kg) bag

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text:
50–86 °F (10–30 °C)
Where temperatures exceed 86 °F (30 °C), refer to and follow ACI hot weather application and protection guidelines.

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
~ 10–20 minutes
The temperature will affect the pot life:
Above 73 °F (23 °C) will reduce the pot life and the working time.
Below 73 °F (23 °C) will extend the pot life and the working time.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Feather edge | 20 minutes
Polyurthane adhesives | > 16 hours

items.label: Yield
items.text:
35 ft2 at 1/8” depth (3.2 m2 at 3 mm)
(Coverage figures do not include allowance for surface profile and porosity or material waste)

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Pour 1.9 Litres of cool potable water into a suitably sized and clean mixing container, using a calibrated measuring jug, or similar, to ensure strict control of the water content (do not over-water). Add Sika® Level SkimCoat to the water, while slowly mixing, adding the complete contents of the 4.5 kg bag.
Mixing with a high-speed drill (> 600 rpm) and a mortar/grout mixing paddle to blend water and powder for 2–3 minutes, continue mixing until a lump-free uniform mix has been produced.
Smaller volumes can also be mixed by hand for 2–3 minutes with a ratio of 3:1 part water. Mix until a uniform, lump free and smooth consistency is achieved.
Avoid entrapment of air and excessive mixing as this will impact performance. Do not mix more mortar than can be used within the stated pot life and working time, taking into consideration ambient temperatures.
Note: avoid using warm water esspecially in hot climates to avoid flash setting.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Using a flat edge steel trowel, apply Sika® Level SkimCoat immediately following mixing.
Ensure that the compound is tightly trowelled into all defects, seams, and non-moving joints or across roughened surfaces as required.
Where defects, details or roughened surfaces require repair or reprofiling to a depth greater than 13 mm, use the appropriate Sika® Level SkimCoat Sikafloor® Leveling products.
